name: Phebe Lamoreux
bioAdditions: FamilySearch's 'Phebe Hart Lamoreaux' (31 Jan 1765 - 5 Apr 1856) is the wife of a James Pringle (1754-1828) (S1). FamilySearch also makes that James Pringle a son of James and Anar Prindle of Newtown, born before their 1759 marriage. Her only source is a Geni/MyHeritage tree. The children's birthplaces (Pennsylvania 1786 and 1790, Orange Co. 1796, New York 1797, Connecticut 1799) suggest the family moved between Plymouth and the Hudson Valley.

sources.citation: FamilySearch published tree, Phebe Lamoreux (GQ6F-4XV), with attached index entries
